person.name: Galia Kropach
person.intro: I’m Galia, a software engineer with 10+ years shipping web applications, from large-scale platforms to products I design and build end to end. I bring a designer’s eye to the interface and an engineer’s care to what makes it work.
about: I studied Architecture and Visual Communication before Computer Science and Psychology. That path still shapes my work: how a system is structured, how an interface feels, and how people actually use it.

I work across frontend and full-stack development, with a focus on precise interfaces, accessible components, and the details that hold up in production. My projects range from internal tools and compliance software to playful ways for children to explore mathematics and AI.

Alongside building, I speak about exploring AI with children and create tools that help families learn together. I’m interested in work where engineering, design, and learning meet, and in teams that care about turning a good idea into something useful.

projects.name: Lega11y
projects.description: Lega11y scans websites for accessibility, privacy, security, and copyright issues, mapping each finding to the laws it touches in Israel, the EU, or the US. The focus is the paper trail: evidence that you knew about an issue and acted on it.
details: Every scan is saved as a record that cannot be changed, tied to a verified identity and an ownership declaration. The aim is to document awareness and action when a legal letter arrives.
The tool also suggests fixes for issues it finds, drafts an AI-generated first reply to a legal letter, and provides a compliance certificate.
A working POC built with my co-founder, Ran Bar-Zik.

projects.name: CFP Manager
projects.description: GetOnStage lists open calls for speakers. Keeping that list current by hand doesn’t scale: public sources use different formats and overlap. I built a local-only, single-user tool that pulls from six sources, normalizes the data into one schema, and detects duplicates against the existing database. It asks for human review only where judgment is needed, and every change goes through a dry-run diff before anything is written.

projects.name: Math Kingdom
projects.description: A bilingual English and Hebrew math adventure for curious kids aged 8+. Explore an illustrated kingdom through playable adventures in infinity, primes, fractals, probability, Fibonacci, topology, and graph theory, with a journal that records discoveries and progress.

projects.name: First Rule
projects.description: A village with no rules, and the children who have to write them. A game about how democratic processes come about. Coming soon.

projects.name: World Cup Galaxy
projects.tagline: A fun bilingual World Cup app for kids
projects.description: A bilingual Hebrew and English World Cup app for children, with match data, quizzes, score predictions, and a sticker album. Built for kids to explore independently or with their parents, with support for multiple player profiles on a shared device.

projects.name: 8 Queens
projects.description: Place eight queens on a chessboard so that no two share a row, column, or diagonal. A puzzle about patterns, constraints, and finding a solution.

projects.name: AI Experience Kit
projects.tagline: Hands-on AI learning for parents and kids
projects.description: A bilingual English and Hebrew kit for exploring AI together. Three browser mini-games cover AI detection, training a classifier, and building prompts, alongside 11 guided activities families can try together.

projects.name: Just Dancing
projects.description: Follow Head, Shoulders, Knees and Toes and get real-time feedback on your moves. A dance-along game using a Teachable Machine pose model and TensorFlow.js to recognize movement through your webcam.
details: Teachable Machine trains the pose classifier and loads the model. Its pose models build on PoseNet for skeleton keypoint estimation.
TensorFlow.js (@tensorflow/tfjs) is pinned to 1.3.1, with npm overrides also pinning tfjs-core and tfjs-converter. Browser webcam capture supplies the video input.
